title: Lightweight, Rubric-Guided Trajectory Evaluation for Production AI Agents
abstract: LiteTrajEval is a budget-bounded trajectory evaluation architecture that derives domain-specific rule profiles offline, deterministically preprocesses and serializes agent trajectories under a fixed budget, and uses a single rubric-guided LLM judge to produce structured diagnostics. The paper evaluates the approach on Magentic-One-style and tau-retail trajectories and reports improved failure-localization alignment with lower evaluation cost and runtime.
